function.name: get_capabilities
function.description: Return ClearAI protocol version, enabled axes, units, mode, and the list of allowed primitive methods. Call this first.

function.name: get_status
function.description: Return enable/moving/HLFB/estop/alert flags, queue depth, and work pose.

function.name: get_pose
function.description: Return work coordinates x,y,z,a in the active units (A in configured A units: deg or rev).

function.name: get_config
function.description: Return live ClearAI config and NVM validity (axis_mask, test_mode, mechanics, vel/accel/decel).

function.name: enable
function.description: Enable ClearPath motors on the configured axis mask. Required before motion.

function.name: disable
function.description: Abruptly stop and disable all motors.

function.name: clear_alerts
function.description: Clear motor alert flags after a fault.

function.name: stop
function.description: Decelerate and stop motion. Motors stay enabled.

function.name: estop
function.description: Immediate stop and disable. Use for safety. Accepted during wait_idle and dwell.

function.name: wait_idle
function.description: Block until queued motion finishes or timeout_ms elapses. Always call after move_linear, move_arc, or jog.

function.name: read_inputs
function.description: Read raw digital input state for ClearCore onboard pins 0-12 (IO-0 through A-12). Omit pin to read all.

pin.description: Pin index 0-12; omit for all pins

function.name: write_output
function.description: Set digital output on IO-0..IO-5 (pin 0-5 only). Sets OUTPUT_DIGITAL mode automatically.

function.name: configure
function.description: Set mechanical parameters, axis mask, and optional soft travel limits (min_x/max_x, etc.). Mechanical fields require motors disabled; limits and test_mode may change while enabled. Persisted to NVM.

test_mode.description: Bench: bypass hardware estop, enable, HLFB, and alert gates

min_x.description: Soft min travel in work units (mm/inch; A always degrees)

max_x.description: Soft max travel in work units

pos_lim_x.description: ClearCore pin index for X+ limit: 0-5 IO (in/out, forced input); 6-12 DI/A (input only); 0 or 255 disables

neg_lim_x.description: ClearCore pin index for X- limit; 0 or 255 disables

function.name: reset_config
function.description: Restore compile-time defaults and clear the NVM config blob. Motors must be disabled first.

function.name: set_test_mode
function.description: Bench test mode: bypass hardware estop (DI-6), HLFB, alert, and enable gates so motion can be commanded without interlocks. Persisted to NVM. Software stop/estop/disable still halt. Default enabled=true if omitted. Not for production.

function.name: set_units
function.description: Set linear units to mm or inch. Axis A is unaffected (use set_units_a).

function.name: set_units_a
function.description: Set the rotary A-axis unit to degrees (deg) or revolutions (rev). Internal storage stays degrees; pose and limits convert accordingly. Persisted to NVM.

function.name: set_mode
function.description: Set absolute or relative coordinate mode for move_linear and move_arc.

function.name: set_work_origin
function.description: G92-style work offset. Empty object zeros all axes at the current machine pose.

function.name: move_linear
function.description: Queue a coordinated XY linear move (optional Z/A). Non-blocking; follow with wait_idle. Requires enable.

feed.description: Feed in current units per minute

function.name: move_arc
function.description: Queue an XY arc. i,j are center offsets from the start (G-code I/J). No Z/A on the same call.

function.name: jog
function.description: Relative jog; ignores abs/rel mode.

function.name: dwell
function.description: Wait seconds (max 600). Interruptible by estop.

function.name: queue_status
function.description: Introspect the coordinated motion queue: number of pending queued segments and whether a move is currently active.

function.name: queue_clear
function.description: Flush the coordinated motion queue: decelerate the active move to a stop and drop all pending queued segments. Motors stay enabled. Accepted during wait_idle/dwell (interrupts the wait).

function.name: home
function.description: Home/zero one axis: seek the configured hardware limit switch for the given axis/dir at a slow feed, decelerate to a stop on contact, optionally back off, then optionally set the work origin to 0 at the final position. Requires the corresponding pos_lim_<axis>/neg_lim_<axis> DI to be configured. Blocking (interruptible by estop/stop/queue_clear).

dir.description: Which limit to seek (pos_lim_<axis> or neg_lim_<axis>)

seek.description: Max travel in work units before giving up (default 1000)

backoff.description: Distance to retract after contact (work units)

zero.description: Set work origin = 0 at the final position (default true)

function.name: probe
function.description: Probe along one axis at a slow feed until a probe input DI triggers, then stop and report the touch position (and optionally zero there). Blocking (interruptible by estop/stop/queue_clear).

pin.description: Probe input DI index 1-12 (not 0/255; cannot be a pin reserved for a limit)

seek.description: Max travel in work units before giving up (default 1000)

backoff.description: Distance to retract after touch (work units)

zero.description: Set work origin = 0 at the touch point (default false)

active.description: Probe trigger polarity (default high: touched = pin reads high)
